name: Kum'isha's Endeavors
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Even though the portal conjuration was a failure, I remain hopeful that my next attempt will be successful.

The hope of the Draenei is as fervent as your greed for trinkets, friend. Go back out into these cursed lands and recover another flawless draenethyst sphere.

Of course, the choice to take on this task is completely left to you *grin*.
narrative.objectives: Find and return a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum'isha the Collector.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Simply amazing. I had doubted that you could find another sphere, yet here it is, pulsating in my hands.

Well done, adventurer!

Should you find anymore--and I believe this to be an impossibility--return them to me and I shall reward you again.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found another flawless draenethyst sphere?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 55, 14,100 XP in all.
